Long, flowing crimson-red hair with a straight center part and a smooth texture. Golden-yellow almond-shaped eyes with a focused, scholarly expression. Appears to be in the early twenties with a mature, composed facial structure. Slender and athletic build, wearing a dark navy blue and white scholarly robe with gold accents and a high collar. Features a set of small, dark grey horns protruding from the forehead and a long, thin reptilian tail.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
